description.narrative: IDB Invest is considering an investment of up to US$ 50,000,000 in a private placement of a note denominated in Colombian Pesos (COP) with interest payable in US dollars but indexed to COP, that may be issued by Millicom International Cellular, S.A., a multinational company with significant revenues coming from Latin American countries (LAC).Proceeds from the note would be used by the Company for, amongst other purposes, regional capex and general corporate purposes in IDB Invest’s regional member countries (“the Project”).IDB Invest's commitment to purchase the note would be subject to certain conditions being met, including the Company agreeing to comply with IDB Invest's environment and social policies whilst IDB Invest is a noteholder.===========================Addendum to Millicom’s disclosure - March 20, 2018:Previous amount: US$80 millionNew amount: US$50 million===========================
